initialization: analytic homogeneous reversal center, realized by the minimum-norm head; labels used to define diagnostic starts
directions: weakest/strongest full effective-Hessian eigenvectors with largest-magnitude entry positive; one isotropic Gaussian full-parameter direction and one independent Gaussian logit direction realized by minimum-norm least squares
optimizer: original ordinary full-batch parameter gradient descent, original dense scalar step, float64, no momentum or weight decay
features: unchanged archived raw ResNet18 features plus bias; SVD only realizes initial states and measures full effective curvature
